---
title: "uv-python params and context parity"
engine: uv-python
format: html
params:
  alpha: yaml-alpha
  beta: yaml-beta
execute:
  echo: false
---

This fixture exercises uv-python-specific `params` mapping and execution context.

```{python}
import json
import os

info_path = os.environ.get("QUARTO_EXECUTE_INFO")
print("EXECUTE_INFO_ENV_PRESENT", bool(info_path))
with open(info_path, encoding="utf-8") as handle:
    execute_info = json.load(handle)

format_info = execute_info["format"]
identifier = format_info["identifier"]

print("PARAM_ALPHA", params["alpha"])
print("PARAM_BETA", params["beta"])
print("PARAM_GAMMA", params.get("gamma", "missing"))
print("PARAM_TOP_LEVEL_ALPHA_PRESENT", "alpha" in globals())
print("EXECUTE_INFO_HAS_PATH", execute_info["document-path"].endswith("examples/parity/params-context.qmd"))
print("EXECUTE_INFO_TARGET_FORMAT", identifier.get("target-format"))
print("EXECUTE_INFO_BASE_FORMAT", identifier.get("base-format"))
print("EXECUTE_INFO_HAS_EXECUTE", isinstance(format_info.get("execute"), dict))
print("EXECUTE_INFO_HAS_RENDER", isinstance(format_info.get("render"), dict))
print("EXECUTE_INFO_HAS_PANDOC", isinstance(format_info.get("pandoc"), dict))
print("EXECUTE_INFO_METADATA_TITLE", format_info.get("metadata", {}).get("title"))
print("QUARTO_PROJECT_DIR_ENV_PRESENT", "QUARTO_PROJECT_DIR" in os.environ)
```

Inline params share the same mapping: beta=`{python} params["beta"]`.
